settings.retentionDescription: Choose how long OpenWAF keeps request history.
settings.adminRetention: Only administrators can view and change the workspace retention policy.
settings.keepLogsDescription: Enter a whole number between 1 and 3650 days. The default is 30 days.
settings.retentionNote: Expired logs are removed automatically. Dashboard statistics only include retained logs.
settings.reducingDescription: Saving a shorter retention period immediately removes logs outside that period. Deleted logs cannot be recovered.
settings.savedDescription: Your log retention policy has been updated.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save settings. Please try again.
settings.daysWhole: Enter a whole number of days
settings.daysMin: Keep logs for at least 1 day
settings.daysMax: Keep logs for at most 3650 days
settings.themeDescription: Use light, dark, or your system theme. Saved on this device.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language for this dashboard. Saved on this device.

services.title: Protected services
services.description: Each service routes one hostname to an origin. Changes take effect immediately.
services.adminOnly: Only administrators can view and change protected services.
services.emptyDescription: Add a hostname and origin so OpenWAF can route and inspect its traffic.
services.name: Name
services.editDescription: Saving replaces this service. The new configuration takes effect immediately.
services.addDescription: OpenWAF matches the hostname and proxies those requests to the upstream origin.
services.nameDescription: A label for this service, up to 255 bytes.
services.hostnameDescription: Hostname or IP address without a port. example.test and 127.0.0.1 are valid.
services.upstreamDescription: HTTP or HTTPS origin, optionally with a port. No credentials, path, query, or fragment.
services.skipTlsDescription: Turn this on only when the HTTPS origin uses a certificate OpenWAF cannot verify.
services.tlsWarningDescription: Traffic to this origin will not be checked for a trusted certificate.
services.deleteDescription: {name} ({hostname}) will stop receiving traffic. Request logs for this service are kept.
services.updatedDescription: The new configuration is already in effect.
services.saveFailed: Could not save the service. Please try again.
services.deletedDescription: {hostname} is no longer routed. Its request logs are kept.
services.deleteFailed: Could not delete the service. Please try again.

validation.nameLength: Name must be 255 bytes or fewer
validation.hostname: Enter a hostname or IP address without a port
validation.upstreamInvalid: Use an HTTP or HTTPS origin without credentials, a path, query, or fragment
validation.portRange: Upstream port must be between 1 and 65535

rules.title: Custom rules
rules.description: Each rule blocks or logs requests that match its conditions. Changes take effect immediately.
rules.adminOnly: Only administrators can view and change custom rules.
rules.emptyDescription: Add a rule to block or log requests by path, header, query parameter, method, or IP address.
rules.name: Name
rules.editDescription: Saving replaces this rule. Its scope stays the same.
rules.addDescription: A matching request is blocked or logged. Every condition must match.
rules.nameDescription: A label for this rule, up to 120 bytes.
rules.notePlaceholder: Stops scans of common admin paths.
rules.scopeDescription: A global rule applies to every service. A service rule applies only to that hostname.
rules.scopeLocked: Scope cannot be changed. Create a new rule for a different scope.
rules.actionDescription: Block stops the request. Log records the match and lets the request through.
rules.enabledDescription: Disabled rules are kept but not applied.
rules.conditionsDescription: Add up to 10 conditions. A request matches only when every condition matches.
rules.conditionLimit: A rule can have at most 10 conditions
rules.updatedDescription: The new configuration is already in effect.
rules.saveFailed: Could not save the rule. Please try again.
rules.deleteFailed: Could not delete the rule. Please try again.

validation.nameLength: Name must be 120 bytes or fewer
validation.noteLength: Description must be 1000 bytes or fewer
validation.key: Query and header conditions need a key of 1 to 128 bytes, without line breaks
validation.value: Value must be 1 to 512 bytes, without line breaks
validation.cidr: Enter a valid CIDR, such as 192.0.2.0/24
validation.cidrTarget: CIDR only works for an IP address
validation.scope: Choose global scope or a service

errors.hostnameTaken: A service with this hostname already exists
errors.serviceInput: A name (up to 255 bytes) and a valid hostname or IP address without a port are required
errors.retentionRange: Log retention must be between 1 and 3650 days
errors.ruleInput: A rule needs a name (1–120 bytes), a description up to 1000 bytes, and 1–10 conditions
errors.ruleAction: Action must be block or log
errors.ruleKeyUnused: A key is only used for query and header conditions
errors.ruleLimit: At most 500 custom rules are allowed
errors.ruleScopeLocked: A rule's scope cannot be changed. Create a new rule instead.
